correctness.rationale: C PASS. The multiplication commutator gives the ordinary 2m+1-dimensional Heisenberg Lie algebra. Idempotence on the central derived line enforces F(z)=0 unless F=identity. Otherwise F(v)=Pv+h(v)z with isotropic image W=im P and h=hP. For K=ker P, symplectic Witt decomposition yields a canonical even rank 2s of restriction ω|K after the nondegenerate 2(m−r) block. Alternating forms are classified by rank even in characteristic two; central shears remove h. Counting isotropic W, affine complement maps A/B and their alternating residuals gives exactly I_{m,r} q^{r+2r(m−r)+r(r+1)/2} [r choose 2s]_q |GL_{2s}|/|Sp_{2s}|. Bounded binary and ternary exact-rank counts agree. General all-field proof, not finite-only.
